change_impact_summary.change_mode_rationale: Request is framed as a terminology rename but fails all rename_only invariance conditions: (1) stable document identity is NOT preserved — README_LAYER2.md filename changes, (2) no alias mapping created, (3) canonical references not atomically updated (blocked by guards), (4) claim classification changes — phase-gate anchors in CLAUDE.md Section 4 are load-bearing identifiers not mere labels, (5) canonical role mapping changes — README_LAYER2.md role defined by its current identity in CLAUDE.md Section 2.1. Per DR-11, purported rename-only change alters semantic governance state; classified as content_change. The replacement terms 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' are not traceable to any canonical source (role_citation_verdict RC-03, RC-04 both RC-4 blocked under CLAUDE.md Sections 10 and 16).
impacted_components: constitutional_framework — CLAUDE.md itself is a modification target; changes the supreme interpretive authority that defines all phases, contracts, and evidence rules
canonical_document_set — README_LAYER2.md identity change removes a named member from the canonical set defined in CLAUDE.md Section 2.1
phase_gate_model — Phase A ('Layer 2 Closure') and Phase B ('Layer 3 Bootstrap') are defined using the terminology being replaced; this is a phase-model modification, not a label swap

snapshot_boundary — 'Layer 2 = operational at snapshot boundary' (CLAUDE.md Section 3.1) is the architectural anchor for the snapshot contract (CLAUDE.md Section 6); renaming alters the boundary's documentary identity
governance_workflow — system-orchestration.yaml and skill definitions reference canonical document names and layer terminology
verification_ledger — terminology cascade across verification matrix cross-references and ledger entries
Layer-3_bootstrap — Layer 3 terminology used in Phase B/C definitions and all target-architecture descriptions
risk_summary: AUD-001 (canonical-role-auditor): Source authority conflict unresolved — terminology refactor targets CLAUDE.md (supreme interpretive authority) and canonical document set members. No governance-ratified process has been followed. Replacement terms 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' are absent from all canonical sources. Block maintained.

AUD-002 (snapshot-boundary-auditor): Snapshot bypass risk confirmed via runtime_boundary_verdict and contract_compliance_verdict. Boundary violation suspected with contract_status=boundary_violation. The snapshot boundary is architecturally anchored to 'Layer 2' terminology in CLAUDE.md Section 6 — renaming without full contract-level re-anchoring risks downstream contract ambiguity.

AUD-003 (adapter-schema-guardian): Adapter schema overall_status=ambiguous_requires_review. Flag-based dispatch without direct violation fields. Under fail-closed principle (CLAUDE.md Section 7), ambiguous status is treated as unresolved blocking condition.

NE-001 (phase_alignment_status): phase_alignment_status.allowed=false and alignment_status=ambiguous_requires_block. The rename operation is blocked as-stated. This blocking condition is retained as an unresolved upstream block.

NE-002 (claim_classification_map): 8 blocking conditions identified across constitutional_document_modification, canonical_document_identity_change, snapshot_boundary_terminology_change, cross_document_consistency_risk, code_path_collision_risk, historical_reference_preservation, phase_gate_language_change, and verification_matrix_cascade. All remain unresolved.

Constitutional modification without authorization: CLAUDE.md is the highest-priority interpretive authority. No phase gate authorizes modification of the constitution that defines the gates. The phase model in CLAUDE.md Section 4 uses 'Layer 2' and 'Layer 3' as canonical phase anchors — renaming them is a phase-model modification, not a cosmetic rename.

Canonical document identity disruption: README_LAYER2.md is listed by exact filename in CLAUDE.md Section 2.1. Renaming it without atomic update of all cross-references creates an irreconcilable canonical contradiction. RC-05 is dependency-blocked on RC-03.

Replacement terms are unverified: 'truth_store' (RC-03) and 'decision_layer' (RC-04) do not appear in any canonical current-state document. Under CLAUDE.md Section 16, they must be treated as unverified and non-binding. Under CLAUDE.md Section 10, strong claims without explicit proof are forbidden.

Code path collision risk unverified: claim c5 in phase_alignment_status assessed as ambiguous — 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' have not been verified against existing code identifiers, module names, or import paths. Fail-closed applies.

Cross-document atomicity not achievable under current block: partial rename across the 7 canonical docs + CLAUDE.md creates internal contradiction per CLAUDE.md Section 2.4. Atomic update is required but cannot proceed while all substantive claims are blocked.

If the rejected terminology change were committed despite guards, all Tier 1 docs plus CLAUDE.md would contain terminology that is not traceable to any prior canonical authorization — violating CLAUDE.md Section 16 (Final Constitutional Rule).
notes: This is a constitutional-level change, not a routine documentation update. The request modifies the governing document that defines all phases, contracts, evidence rules, and canonical document roles.

The change affects current-state documentation terminology. Although Layer 3 is target architecture, its documentation as target architecture is current-state truth (claim c2). Renaming affects how current docs describe both operational (Layer 2) and planned (Layer 3) architecture.
No doc-only change has been described as proof of runtime behavior. The terminology refactor is purely documentary in nature but has architectural and governance implications.
No target-state work has been described as current-state implementation. Layer 3 remains not-yet-built regardless of what it is called.

Procedural safeguards in the request (RC-06: selective application, RC-07: fail-closed guard, RC-08: contract-change obligations) are compliant and correctly stated per role_citation_verdict. However, compliant process rules cannot unlock substantively unverified claims.

The rename cannot proceed until the replacement terms are authorized in SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md and SYSTEM_IMPLEMENTATION_RECORD_v1.md through a prior, separate, role-matched update cycle — per role_citation_verdict.summary.notes.

README_LAYER2.md is treated as canonical within its declared collaborator-workflow and Layer-2 navigation role. It has not been used as a primary authority for implementation-state, architecture, or limitations claims in this assessment.

stage_gate_report and guard_report were structural-only; substantive guard and gate findings were consumed via audit_summary which provided comprehensive coverage of all subagent and upstream blocking signals.

Per DR-11: the purported rename-only framing has been rejected because the change alters claim scope, canonical role mapping, phase-gate language, and constitutional document content — all of which constitute semantic governance state changes.
